notes.title: Patch 1 | Shieven - Abyss
notes.notes:
Fixed:
[list]
[*] Some collision that caused you to fall in the [spoiler] grid doors area after you fall [/spoiler]
[*] First text of the subtitles of any vhs being in spanish at first.
[*] Settings menu overlapping with the controls section if a controler was connected.
[*] A bug where repeatedly picking up an inspectable item causes multiple instances to overlap, leading to performance issues and negatively impacting the player's experience.
[/list]

Improved:
[list]
[*] The puzzle in the center is now easier, as it was previously too confusing. Additionally, a new document has been added to assist the player.
[*] Improved performance by switching from Lumen to Screenspace for better optimization.
[/list]

Coming soon:
[list]
[*] Additional languages: Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, and French.
[*] Full controller support.
[*] UI improvements.
[/list]

Thanks for sticking out in this update. Have fun!
